findings.summary: The initial engine-pin repair advanced the canonical tool manifest to an org-only version that the declared nuget.org read path could not resolve.
evidence: Initial diff 3e7499d4 changed dist/dotnet/.config/dotnet-tools.json from 0.50.0 to 0.52.0, while /tmp/m0-feed-live-a7c91.log recorded FS.GG.Coord.Cli 0.52.0 on the org feed and only 0.51.1 on nuget.org.
docs/adr/0039-nuget-org-is-the-read-path.md decisions 1 and 3 identify nuget.org as the anonymous read and restore path and make its publish critical.

A live review query through scripts/fsgg_feed.nuget_org_versions returned newest stable 0.51.1 and confirmed that 0.52.0 was absent; git show 068954a9 showed Renovate had advanced this native NuGet pin to 0.51.1 from that read path.
resolution_evidence: Repair commit c42bcb51062391f3c6b58a589a079eb45aadba01 restores dist/dotnet/.config/dotnet-tools.json to 0.51.1 and changes scripts/check-engine-pin.py to compare the org feed with nuget.org while selecting the pin target from nuget.org.

tests/engine-pin/run.sh at c42bcb5 adds the org-ahead partial-release case and a negative control proving that an org-only pin is rejected as AHEAD of the read feed; the suite passed 20 of 20 assertions.

/tmp/m0-pin-live-r1-a7c91.log confirms the exact repaired head retains pin 0.51.1, observes org 0.52.0, classifies the state as PARTIAL RELEASE, and exits successfully without demanding an unresolvable bump.
